_why: Dotted paths (list indexes as numbers; a path ending .* allows everything under it) that may differ from a broker ledger golden, keyed <lane>/<golden> (e.g. demand/transitions). Empty: no difference is allowed. A PR that changes a ledger's behaviour on purpose names each path it changes here; the edit is reviewed with the PR, and the integrity job (bin/goldens/golden-integrity.py) holds the committed goldens to the merge-base tree's behaviour everywhere else.
